description: Move prospects in bulk. Move the prospects for up to 1,000 records between active, opportunity, and archived in one call: the bulk form of the single update, and what the app’s selection action bar runs. Records that are not prospects are skipped, as are prospects already in the requested lifecycle; the response counts each. Archiving always ends each prospect’s mail and, unless `cascade` is false, closes its open opportunities. List memberships are kept either way. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

cascade.description: When archiving: also close each prospect’s open opportunities. Mail always ends, including when false. List memberships are kept either way. Default true.

lifecycle.description: Where every prospect in the selection moves. Records that are not prospects, and prospects already there, are skipped and counted.

items.description: Record ID: `prop_123`, `person_456`, `company_7`, or the bare number.

record_type.description: What kind of record the prospect tracks.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.

name: dealmachine_patch_prospects
